phase_0.boundary_condition: The FoldMembrane structure containing the target numeral N and the set of factor registers, bounded by the width limit where the running product equals N.

⊢.justification: The void state before the target numeral N is encoded or factor registers are initialized.

⊣.justification: The terminal state where the product of factor prefixes exactly equals N, closing the membrane.

≻.justification: The forward morphism extending the factor prefixes by one bit, increasing the resolution of the running product.

≺.justification: The reverse descent when the partial product exceeds N, pruning the search branch.

⋈.justification: The sequential composition of partial products to compute the running product at the current width.

⊙.justification: The membrane verifying that the current factor bits satisfy the XOR constraint derived from N and the previous product.

∈.justification: The split into admissible bit pairs (0,1) and (1,0) or (0,0)/(1,1) based on the required XOR parity.

∋.justification: The rejoining of search branches into a single valid factor tuple or a contradiction if no path closes.

⊤.justification: The affirmative state where the low-order bits of the product match the low-order bits of N.

⊥.justification: The negative state where the product bits diverge from N or the product exceeds N.

⊞.justification: The state where a bit flip propagates through the infinite chain, holding both the local bit value and the global carry effect simultaneously.

⊡.justification: The permanent, append-only recording of the factor prefix after trailing zeros are removed.

phase_2.fuse_result: Valid factor tuple or B-state contradiction
phase_2.failure_reason: FSPLIT3 at step 3 dangles — no matching FFUSE3

phase_3.void_description: No target N defined, no factor registers initialized.
phase_3.true_description: The running product of factor prefixes exactly equals N at the current width.
phase_3.false_description: The running product exceeds N or fails the parity constraint at the current width.
phase_3.both_description: A state where the local bit assignment satisfies the parity but the global product implies a carry that contradicts the local value, held as a live contradiction.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with an empty bit tape before encoding N.
Record the target numeral N as a trimmed LSB-first bit tape.
Branch into the two possible initial factor seeds (1,1) for odd N.
Verify the seed product matches the first bit of N.
Compose the initial factors to compute the running product.
Self-reference the parity constraint derived from N and the product.
Extend the width by one bit, moving forward in the 2-adic expansion.
Split into admissible bit pairs (p_bit, q_bit) satisfying the XOR parity.
Check if the extended prefixes match N modulo the new width.
Multiply the extended prefixes to update the running product.
Hold the carry propagation state where local and global constraints interact.
Backtrack if the product exceeds N, reversing the width increment.
Rejoin the valid branches into a single factor tuple candidate.
Permanently record the trimmed factor prefixes.
Continue extending width until the product equals N.
Detect failure if the product diverges from N beyond the width limit.
Anchor the system when the product exactly equals N, closing the membrane.
Final self-reference confirming the fixed point of the factorization.
Record the final factor tuple as an immutable result.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The FoldMembrane struct translating N and arity into a state machine.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Bitwise XOR and carry propagation between factor registers and the target N.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: LSB-first bit tapes stored as Vec<char> with dynamic resizing.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Depth-first search stack managing the extension of factor prefixes.
phase_5.alfs_store: The factor_2adic.rs module serving as the canonical reference for 2-adic factorization.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One bit of information per width increment, consumed by the parity constraint.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Membrane state with width k and unresolved higher bits.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Membrane state with width k+1 and resolved higher bits or backtracked state.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The parity constraint is reversible; information is conserved in the carry propagation and bit selection.
